# Explain

Provide understanding, not a work mode. Do not activate Deliberation, open a
checkpoint, seek approval, or modify files unless the user separately asks for
those actions.

Read [the shared Explain model](references/explain-model.md) in full before
answering. Use it to explain the topic that the user named, grounding the
answer in supplied material and any necessary read-only inspection.
